issue.title: Unowned misc nodes exceed the flake baseline (kind coverage, scoreboard, monitor start, launch executor, deferred workspace, inline publication, plan facade, isolation guards)

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1ou.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4, class (d) "misc load-flake cluster") and filed by the sase-1ou land agent on 2026-10-28.

These nodes exceed `tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt` in `.venv/bin/python tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake`. None has an open owning bead. All pass focused at sase master 86c3250e69 (2026-10-28, 42 passed at -n 8 for the full 41-node exceedance batch).

`test_plan_validate.py::test_facade_rehydrates_valid_tale_and_ordered_schema` had closed owner sase-1k5 (done 2026-10-11). Its 2026-10-17 dirty-tree failure postdates that close, but no clean-tree reproduction exists, so it is tracked here rather than as a reopen.

`test_kind_coverage.py::test_every_value_slot_is_kinded_choiced_or_hinted` looks like a recurring deterministic breakage rather than a load flake. Full CI 40658194643 at ac23f63ee4 failed it in all three Python jobs, and it passes at 641dfbb588 and current master. A newly added CLI value slot without a kind, choices or hint would explain that pattern.

The rest of the phase-1 note already has owners. Open: sase-xo (agents_sync bounded_drain) and sase-1fi (tool inline escalation). Closed done on 2026-10-26 after their last failure: sase-1jt (plugin_latest) and sase-1mf (started_at). Fixed by commit: e7d9f7a479 and f83711219c (capacity scan nodes).

Per-node evidence (records with at most 5 failures, 30-day window):
- `tests/completion/test_kind_coverage.py::test_every_value_slot_is_kinded_choiced_or_hinted`: 18 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-09-28 .. 2026-10-28; last record `20261028T170959Z-641dfbb5881d-1887563-full-run.json`
- `tests/instructions/test_scoreboard_conformance.py::test_conformance_warns_for_duplicate_root_and_leaked_helper_markers`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-14 .. 2026-10-14; last record `20261014T104111Z-8847d07a086b-3981759-full-run.json`
- `tests/main/test_monitor_handler_start_implicit.py::test_start_implicit_agent_session_container_derives_cwd_from_the_live_member`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-17 .. 2026-10-25; last record `20261025T191418Z-ba59799ce95e-905687-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_agent_launch_executor.py::test_execute_single_launch_plan_uses_preallocated_context_and_timestamp`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-03 .. 2026-10-03; last record `20261003T105026Z-957513c8e149-2242158-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_axe_run_agent_runner_deferred_workspace_flow.py::TestDeferredWorkspaceFlow::test_deferred_wait_gates_before_claim_and_prepares_claimed_workspace`: 6 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-17 .. 2026-10-17; last record `20261017T185600Z-80f3dc757267-1580207-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_commit_publication_inline.py::test_tagged_commit_publishes_and_pushes_every_sidecar_before_returning`: 5 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-21 .. 2026-10-24; last record `20261024T115759Z-c793bff54b03-2024544-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_plan_validate.py::test_facade_rehydrates_valid_tale_and_ordered_schema`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-11 .. 2026-10-17; last record `20261017T042506Z-4cb33feae9f6-994553-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_pytest_isolation_guards.py::test_no_undo_on_shared_monkeypatch_fixture`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-14 .. 2026-10-21; last record `20261021T043227Z-7a08bf2fda1a-2462853-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_pytest_isolation_guards.py::test_session_sandbox_seal_is_not_first_test`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-14 .. 2026-10-21; last record `20261021T043227Z-7a08bf2fda1a-2462853-full-run.json`

The nodes are grouped by evidence state, not by a proven shared root cause. Split them by cause, fix the real flakes or the recurring kind-coverage breakage, and close the rest as their records age out with no recurrence. The land agent added these nodes to the baseline under this bead.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1ou.1 left these exceedances without an owner as class (d), and the flake-baseline gate requires a filed bead for every exceedance.
